title: 第一部分 基础训练 TEST 6

sections.title: 阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
* **Teaching Tornero** by Georgeanne Irvine
Tornero is a two-toed sloth (二趾树懒) who lives at the San Diego Zoo. When he was born in 2019, he weighed less than a pound. Read about how he was cared for to become the 18-pound, healthy sloth he is today.
* **Epic Animal Journeys** by Ed Brown
Birds, fish, and other animals are born knowing how to migrate (move from one area to another). How do fish cross oceans and birds fly to a different place—and not get lost? With great descriptions (形容), this book explains how they do it.
* **Detector Dogs, Dynamite Dolphins** by Christina Couch and Cara Giaimo
This book talks about animals that have special abilities (能力), including a dog that is trained to find killer whales. You'll see many photos and pictures in this book.
* **The Who, What, Why of Zoology** by Jules Howard
This book describes how researchers study and communicate with animals. It is an exciting book on the field of science and animals. It brings science to life and is a perfect book for readers aged 8-12.

questions.prompt: What can we know about Tornero?
options: He loses one of his toes.
He was well taken care of.
He is thin and active.
He was born in 2009.
questions.translation: 关于Tornero我们能知道什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一本书介绍中的“Read about how he was cared for to become the 18-pound, healthy sloth he is today.”可知，他得到了悉心的照料，成长为健康的树懒。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: What does Epic Animal Journeys mainly talk about?
options: How to train dogs.
How animals migrate.
How to make a quick journey.
How researchers communicate with animals.
questions.translation: 《Epic Animal Journeys》主要讲述了什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二本书介绍“...explains how they do it”以及前文描述鱼类和鸟类迁徙（migrate）的内容可知，这本书主要讲述动物是如何迁徙的。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is written by two writers?
options: Teaching Tornero.
Epic Animal Journeys.
The Who, What, Why of Zoology.
Detector Dogs, Dynamite Dolphins.
questions.translation: 以下哪本书是由两位作者共同撰写的？
questions.explanation: 根据第三本书的作者“by Christina Couch and Cara Giaimo”可知，《Detector Dogs, Dynamite Dolphins》是由两位作者写的。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: Who might be interested in reading The Who, What, Why of Zoology most?
options: doctor who treats animals.
teacher who teaches geography.
pupil who likes science and animals.
film maker who is making a sci-fi movie.
questions.translation: 谁可能对阅读《The Who, What, Why of Zoology》最感兴趣？
questions.explanation: 根据第四本书介绍“It is an exciting book on the field of science and animals... is a perfect book for readers aged 8-12.”可知，适合8-12岁且对科学和动物感兴趣的小学生。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: In which part of a magazine can we find the passage most?
options: Art.
People.
Animals.
Science.
questions.translation: 我们在杂志的哪个部分最能找到这篇文章？
questions.explanation: 文章推荐的四本书都是关于动物（树懒、动物迁徙、搜救探测动物、动物学）的，因此最可能出现在杂志的“动物（Animals）”版块。因此答案为C。

sections.title: 阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
On August 21, 2023, a cargo ship (货船) traveling from Singapore to Brazil, called *Pyxis Ocean*, became the first to try out a new kind of sail (帆). The sail is expected to help save fuel (燃料) and cut pollution. About 2.1% of the world's CO2 pollution comes from shipping. If it works well, similar sails could become common on cargo ships over the next few years.

The new sail is called a "WindWing". When the ship is at sea, the WindWing can be raised and turned to catch the wind, helping the ship move forward. When the weather is <u>rough</u>, the WindWing should be put down on the ship's deck (甲板) to prevent it from being broken.

In this test, *Pyxis Ocean* was able to reach speeds (速度) of up to 10 kph using just the WindWings, and no fuel at all. Computer studies showed that each WindWing can save 1,650 kg of fuel every day. *Pyxis Ocean* has two WindWings. They should cut the ship's pollution by about 30%.

The exciting thing about WindWings is that, if they work well, they can be used on many cargo ships that are now running on fuel. Researchers hope that by 2025, half of new cargo ships will be able to come with the new sail.

Later in September, another cargo ship left Shanghai, China—this time with four WindWings.

questions.prompt: What's the advantage of the WindWing?
options: It helps save fuel and cut pollution.
It can make the cargo ship much safer.
It helps the cargo ship travel faster.
It can be used in all weather conditions.
questions.translation: WindWing的优势是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“The sail is expected to help save fuel and cut pollution.”可知，这种风帆的优势在于帮助节省燃料和减少污染。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "rough" mean in Paragraph 2?
options: Cold.
Bad.
Sunny.
Pleasant.
questions.translation: 第2段中画线的单词“rough”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“When the weather is rough, the WindWing should be put down on the ship's deck to prevent it from being broken.”可知，当天气恶劣/糟糕时，应将风帆降下以防损坏，rough在这里表示“恶劣的、糟糕的（Bad）”。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: How much fuel can Pyxis Ocean save every day?
questions.translation: Pyxis Ocean每天可以节省多少燃料？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“each WindWing can save 1,650 kg of fuel every day. Pyxis Ocean has two WindWings.”可知，每个风帆每天可节省1650千克，这艘船有2个风帆，因此一共每天节省 1650 × 2 = 3300 千克。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: Most of the world's CO2 pollution comes from shipping.
Pyxis Ocean could reach speeds of up to 10 kph with fuel.
Pyxis Ocean is the second cargo ship to travel with WindWings.
The cargo ship that left Shanghai has two more WindWings than Pyxis Ocean.
questions.translation: 根据文章，以下哪项是正确的？
questions.explanation: 根据文章倒数第三段“Pyxis Ocean has two WindWings”和最后一段“another cargo ship left Shanghai... with four WindWings”可知，上海出发的货船有4个风帆，比Pyxis Ocean多2个（4 - 2 = 2）。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: What's the passage mainly about?
options: new way to stop producing pollution.
new journey from Singapore to Brazil.
new kind of sail that is friendly to the environment.
new cargo ship that uses some kind of wind power.
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲了什么？
questions.explanation: 文章主要介绍了一种名为WindWing的新型环保风帆在货船上的测试应用及其节能减排的前景，因此“A new kind of sail that is friendly to the environment”最符合主旨。因此答案为C。

sections.title: 阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Sometimes, all it takes to make a day better is a smile, whether it's one someone gives to you or one you share with another. A nice smile can not only bring warmth to others but also make the world a better place.

Look at the smiley face above. It has become one of the most famous symbols in the world. The smiley face is a circle with two dots (点) and an upturned curve (向上翘的曲线). Harvey Ball put them together in 1963. Do you know why he used the color yellow for the smiley face? Well, that's because it is the symbol of happiness.

With the purpose of spreading (传播) simple joy and love to everyone, Harvey created World Smile Day in 1999. Since then, people have celebrated the day on the first Friday in October every year. Sadly, Harvey died in 2001. To remember him, people set up the Harvey Ball World Smile Foundation (基金). The foundation has carried on Harvey's work and has been spreading simple joy and love since its foundation.

In 2024, World Smile Day will be celebrated on October 4. There are a lot of activities you can do to celebrate it, but it all starts with keeping your eyes and heart open to people around you. Why not do something to share love and make a difference on World Smile Day?

questions.prompt: What's the main idea of the first paragraph?
options: We need to learn to share.
Smile is good for our health.
It's important to bring warmth to others.
Smile can make a big difference.
questions.translation: 第一段的主旨是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“...all it takes to make a day better is a smile... make the world a better place.”可知，微笑能让一天变得更好，让世界变得更美好，即微笑能产生很大影响（make a big difference）。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: Why did Harvey use yellow for the smiley face?
options: Because he liked the color best.
Because the color stands for happiness.
Because the color is a symbol of love.
Because the color was popular at that time.
questions.translation: 哈维为什么在笑脸上使用黄色？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段最后“Well, that's because it is the symbol of happiness.”可知，因为黄色代表快乐。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is the correct order?
options: ①②③
①③②
②①③
②③①
questions.translation:
以下哪项是正确的顺序？
① Harvey设计了笑脸（1963年）。
② Harvey创立了世界微笑日（1999年）。
③ 人们成立了Harvey Ball世界微笑基金会（2001年之后）。
questions.explanation: 根据时间线：1963年设计笑脸（①）-> 1999年创立世界微笑日（②）-> 2001年哈维去世后人们成立基金会（③）。正确顺序为①②③。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: People will celebrate the 2024 World Smile Day on ________.
options: October 3
October 4
October 5
October 6
questions.translation: 人们将在 ________ 庆祝2024年的世界微笑日。
questions.explanation: 根据第四段第一句“In 2024, World Smile Day will be celebrated on October 4.”可知，将在10月4日庆祝。因此答案为B。

sections.title: 阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
As cheerful as Mother's Day events are, they can also make those without mothers feel left out. Trying not to let his daughter miss out on the celebrations, a loving single father named Lookphonbodee had an idea. [1] So he got a dress and showed up to his kid's Mother's Day school get-together.

In Thailand, Mother's Day is celebrated on August 12. On this day, local schools hold special parties where students hug their mothers and give them flowers. The proud father, also known as "Teacher Joe", works as a PE teacher at the school where his daughter Nong Cream studies. "When the school organizes Mother's Day activities, I don't want my child to be sad," Joe said.

A video of the Mother's Day event was recorded by Joe and posted online. <u>It</u> soon became a hot topic and touched many people. In the video, he is dressed in a black and white dress and wears a long wig (假发). He is then given a big hug by his daughter, who smiles with joy as she is cradled (轻轻抱着) by her father.

Thanks to Joe's idea, what could have been a difficult day ended up being a happy memory that they'll both remember forever. "I don't feel embarrassed (尴尬的). This year's Mother's Day, I want to say I love my father," Nong Cream said. "Thank you, Dad, for raising me and making me happy."

questions.prompt: Which of the following can be put back in the blank [1]?
options: He decided to dress up as a mother.
They always found ways to have fun together.
He gave several kisses on his daughter's head.
He wanted to tell his daughter the truth carefully.
questions.translation: 以下哪项可以放回第1段的空格 [1] 处？
questions.explanation: 根据后一句“So he got a dress and showed up to his kid's Mother's Day school get-together.”可知，父亲决定男扮女装扮成母亲参加聚会。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: What can we know from the second paragraph?
options: Mother's Day parties are often held at home.
Mother's Day is celebrated in spring in Thailand.
Joe is a PE teacher who works at his daughter's school.
Joe doesn't want his daughter to take part in this activity.
questions.translation: 从第二段中我们可以知道什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“works as a PE teacher at the school where his daughter Nong Cream studies”可知，Joe是一名体育老师，在他女儿就读的学校工作。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "It" refer to in Paragraph 3?
options: The long wig.
The black and white dress.
The Mother's Day activity.
The video of the Mother's Day event.
questions.translation: 第3段中画线的单词“It”指代什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段前句“A video of the Mother's Day event was recorded by Joe and posted online. It soon became a hot topic...”可知，It指代的是母亲节活动的这段视频。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: Nong Cream felt full of ________ on this year's Mother's Day.
options: regrets
happiness
loneliness
embarrassment
questions.translation: Nong Cream在今年的母亲节感受到了满满的 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“...ended up being a happy memory... Thank you, Dad, for raising me and making me happy.”可知，她感到非常幸福快乐（happiness）。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: The writer writes the passage to ________.
options: tell a touching story
describe a big event
make a polite suggestion
introduce a traditional festival
questions.translation: 作者写这篇文章是为了 ________。
questions.explanation: 文章讲述了一位单亲父亲为了不让失去母亲的女儿在学校母亲节活动中感到孤单失落，扮成母亲参加活动的感人故事（a touching story）。因此答案为A。

sections.title: 任务型阅读 E
sections.instruction: 根据短文内容，从选项中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项。选项中有一项为多余项。
sections.passage:
**MUSIC THERAPY**

Everyone enjoys music. But do you know it can improve the lives of sick kids?

[1] In fact, music has changed the world a lot. In Australia, a scientist, Catherine, has made a music program. [2] "Music can make you feel happy, and music can make you feel relaxed and take away any stress," said Catherine.

For thousands of years people have believed that music has a great effect on both the mind and the body, but it was only about 70 years ago that scientists began to study its medical benefits (益处). [3] Since then, music has been used to help patients. It's even been used to help kids in schools get better marks because it allows them to relax and pay more attention.

Now music is being used in a special program called Music Therapy (音乐疗法). [4] It includes listening to music, playing instruments, singing, songwriting and other games.

Sophia is 11. She got cancer five months ago, but playing music, learning new songs and singing have become part of her life. She said, "It takes my mind off feeling sick. While I am listening to music, it tells me not to give up hope. [5]"

It seems that a few minutes of music a day can help keep the doctor away!
wordbank: It helps people improve their quality of life in many different ways by using music.
So soon music became popular all over the world.
It feels like soon my life will turn around and I'll be strong again.
Music is more than just entertainment.
They found that playing music in hospitals helped sick soldiers feel better.
The program has been putting smiles on the faces of kids in hospitals across the country.

questions.translation: 音乐不仅仅是娱乐。
questions.explanation: 上一段提到音乐能否改善患病儿童的生活，后一句提到“In fact, music has changed the world a lot.（事实上音乐很大程度改变了世界）”，填入“音乐不仅仅是娱乐”承上启下，引出音乐在治疗方面的作用。对应选项D。

The program has been putting smiles on the faces of kids in hospitals across the country.

questions.translation: 它通过音乐以多种不同的方式帮助人们提高生活质量。
questions.explanation: 前句介绍了音乐疗法（Music Therapy），本句承接解释音乐疗法的作用机制，后句继续补充“It includes listening to music, playing instruments...”。对应选项A。
